summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 18 June 2026 announcing the repurchase of 5,000,000 of its own ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International. Shares were acquired on 18 June 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 105.4485 pence per share, with a high of 106.0p and low of 104.55p. This is part of an existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. Shares purchased will be cancelled. The filing is a routine disclosure of an open-market buyback, not a formal tender offer or special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity is noted. The buyback is a capital return activity, but as it is a standing programme it does not trigger special-situation classification.
